summary: The Executive Committee will make recommendations on the 2019 Rate Supported Budgets - 2019 Water and Wastewater Consumption Rates and Service Fees to City Council for its consideration on March 7, 2019.
decided: City Council on March 7, 2019, adopted the following: Rates and Fees 1.
